instruction: look at part_with_vise.step. Create a setup using the two vise jaws already modeled in the STEP file as fixtures. Machine the two top pockets while keeping every low-level tool position at least 3 mm horizontally clear of the fixture whenever Z is below 18 mm. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill suitable for the two top pockets while maintaining fixture clearance. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export task-11.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
